**Access boundary:** Local candidate; distribution needs separate proof.

Development helper implementation. Provider/setup observations are dated 4 October 2026; fresh-task restoration and current provider access remain separately unqualified.

**Surfaces:** Repository CLI and development runtime only; no new product browser, native, REST or MCP surface.

[Read the engineering guide](/engineering/ai-contributions/) · [All features](/features/)

## Capabilities

<ol>
<li id="feature-365397d80141">Repository-authorized development with the package.json Node.js engine range, npm, Git, bash and curl; no elevation of human workshop roles or the connected product assistant</li>
<li id="feature-70f6ad4fb4f5">Credential-filtered bootstrap installs locked dependencies, applies local D1 migrations and fixtures, and builds the web application; optional Linux Chromium preparation retains separate browser and native qualification</li>
<li id="feature-f6c170c5043b">Repository CLI/API and official HTTPS documentation remain usable when desktop plugins are absent; missing provider access blocks only dependent work while source changes and local simulation continue</li>
<li id="feature-da6de3e89f05">Offline configuration inventory and bounded redacted GET diagnostics preserve managed proxy and certificate settings; credentials enter curl through stdin, with no secret arguments, redirects, automatic retries or provider payload output</li>
<li id="feature-70af2be4331c">Missing configuration, unverified credentials, authentication failure, access denial and network errors remain separate outcomes; successful reads never prove unrestricted functionality or a read-only credential</li>
<li id="feature-8962aba45d1e">Historical 4 October 2026 setup observations include exact-host Cloudflare and Telnyx network secrets, Cloudflare metadata-only permissions and a dedicated Telnyx key without native read-only scope; no desktop-session export or production-secret files</li>
<li id="feature-b7e2e4c344bc">Dated developer evidence retains the original helper tests, hosted simulation and partial HTTP smoke observations; restored fresh-task access and current provider readiness require new observations</li>
<li id="feature-552d347be4f7">Bootstrap and diagnostics grant no expert mandate, communication approval, paid provisioning, billing activation, production mutation or deployment; web, native, REST and MCP product contracts are unchanged</li>
</ol>
